summary: A recurring SoulCollage® open studio facilitated by Michelle Parkerson, a SoulCollage Facilitator, held roughly monthly at Quietude (now "The Lodge") in Black Mountain as a free community offering. It runs its own Meetup group, "SoulCollage: Create & Connect," with 43 members and a 5.0 rating across 3 reviews, and Parkerson also runs sister sessions (open studio, card reading group) at other Asheville venues, suggesting an actual returning practice community rather than a one-off class.

evidence.note: Listings describe a recurring drop-in open studio, "new and experienced practitioners welcome," in a small-circle/small-group setting, facilitated by the same person (Michelle Parkerson) each time.

Dedicated Meetup group "SoulCollage: Create & Connect" has 43 members and a 5.0 rating from 3 reviews, organized by Michelle Parkerson, with regular monthly events across multiple Asheville-area locations including the Quietude/White Horse Community Hub partnership.
Independent listing confirms free drop-in format with a small material fee, no registration required, framed as an ongoing community offering rather than a one-time class.

Search results also surface a related, separately-run "SoulCollage Card Reading Group with Michelle Parkerson" on Eventbrite, indicating a broader recurring practice community around this facilitator rather than a single isolated event series.
